snippet.title: Waste Your Wedding  - Trailer
snippet.description:
Waste Your Wedding is an aerial fighting side-scroller, with around 40 minutes of gameplay.

A hungry woman wanders in a wedding venue to eat a gigantic cake.
But can she stop her suitors from marrying her along the way?
A light-hearted adventure starts!

Available on itch.io: https://antoine-foucault.itch.io/waste-your-wedding
